act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.offence: Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof.
classification.punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof
section.html: Whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
section.text: Whoever abets the committing of mutiny by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman, in the Army, Navy or Air Force of the Government of India, shall, if mutiny be committed in consequence of that abetment, be punished with death or with imprisonment for life, or imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine.
